notes:
Passed on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked; never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null and no hardware run was made. ENTRY CHOICE: the card lists AuboI5Env and UR5eEnv; one package serves one device, so this package implements AuboI5Env, the environment that composes the Aubo i5 arm with the card's AG95 gripper. UR5eEnv is named in facts.md and was not implemented. The card's ag95/scene.xml is a standalone scene not loaded by the environment; the environment loads aubo_i5.xml and ag95.xml through the robot classes. MOCK PATH: the card prefers upstream-sim, but mujoco, dm_control and gymnasium are not installed, the gate never installs the upstream package and package code never imports the clone, so backends['fake'] is this package's pure Python stand-in. It mirrors the public reset/step/render/close API and both spaces, keeps a tick counter and returns the upstream constant zeros(6) observation; it integrates no rigid-body, contact, tendon or actuator dynamics, does not render and was never compared with the upstream environment. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run. FIDELITY: declared F0 (kinematic stand-in, no dynamics) with engine gymnasium:manipulator_mujoco/AuboI5Env-v0, timestep 2 ms from the arena, realtime_factor 0, lockstep clock, full reset and no snapshot/restore; the upstream MuJoCo model would justify F1 and the gaps disclose the difference. The upstream step ignores its action argument (a TODO in the clone), so no action changes modelled state; the bridge still enforces the -0.1..0.1 per-element action bounds before any call. The observation space is unbounded and the state observation is the constant zeros(6). LIMITS: no driver limit is declared and none is operator_required; the action bounds are derived by the Gymnasium bridge from the environment's Box action space, and ticks is the bridge's 1..10000 schema bound. No site-limits.example.json is needed because no bound is operator_required, and no x-cap id was used, so there are no catalogue_requests. RISK/STOP: simulated R1, above the card's R0 floor because the capability advances a simulated robot (simulation stepping); there is no hardware backend and no native stop, so the runtime software e-stop latch is the only stop path and no physical e-stop exists because no hardware is modelled. WARNINGS: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only selects the next reset and makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived seed (twice), ticks and action.values; these are expected simulator-family warnings and no G4 citation warning was left. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo model, OSC, contacts, tendons, joint states, render frames and any physical Aubo i5 or AG95; no hardware run and no human review. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every run and is not part of the package.
